units.source_text: 我從小就對女人做過各種觀察，雖同屬於人類，卻感覺是與男人迥然不同的生物，

en.t: Since childhood, I had made all kinds of observations about women; although they belonged to the same human race, they felt like creatures utterly different from men,

units.source_text: 而且莫測費解，時刻不能鬆懈對她們的警覺，不可思議的是，卻是這些女人一直呵護著我。

en.t: Moreover, they were inscrutable and hard to fathom, and I could never relax my vigilance around them; strangely enough, it was those women who kept looking after me.

units.source_text: 「被迷戀」和「被喜歡」都不符合我，

en.t: Neither being adored nor being liked suited my case,

units.source_text: 反而是「被呵護」這一說法更貼近我的實情。

en.t: Rather, saying that I was looked after came closer to the truth of my situation.

units.source_text: 對待搞笑，女人比男人更顯得舒心隨意。

en.t: When it came to clowning, women seemed more relaxed and at ease than men.

units.source_text: 我每次搞笑時，男人不會總是哈哈大笑，

en.t: Whenever I played the fool, men did not always burst out laughing,

units.source_text: 而且我心裡也清楚，在男人面前過於得意忘形地搞笑，肯定會招致失敗，

en.t: and I also knew perfectly well that if I got too carried away clowning in front of men, I was sure to fail,

units.source_text: 所以我特別留意見好就收。

en.t: so I took special care to stop while things were still going well.
